correctness.rationale: The full corrected RESULT.md now asserts ONLY the arbitrary-factor join theorem and its iterated-join corollary. Proper coloring of a join partitions the color labels uniquely between factors; a vertex is CDV in the join if and only if it is CDV under its factor coloring because it automatically sees every opposite-side color. Restriction therefore gives an exact bijection for every nonempty proper label subset I and preserves every per-class CDV multiplicity, proving B_{G∨H}(S)=sum B_G(S_I)B_H(S_complement). Induction/partition by all factor palettes gives the iterated formula. Independent direct labeled proper-coloring enumerations for K1∨P3, K2∨P3 and K2∨K2 reproduced the product cardinalities and CDV profiles. The entire previously covered complete-multipartite claim is REMOVED from the final theorem and slogan, not passed by disclaimer.
